usageNotes: Returns the list of SDN sub-resources available under a specific node (e.g., zones, vnets, interfaces). Use this as an index/discovery call before drilling into node-level SDN configuration — the returned items act as child links. Accessible to all authenticated users; no special privilege is required.

examples.summary: List SDN sub-resources on node pve1

tips: The response is an array of child link objects; follow each item's 'name' field to traverse deeper into SDN configuration (zones, vnets, etc.).
This endpoint is node-scoped — SDN policy is cluster-wide but some state is queried per-node; run against the node where you need to inspect local SDN status.
Use the cluster-level SDN endpoints (/cluster/sdn) to manage SDN configuration; this endpoint is read-only discovery only.
